patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bolt for Business and Gusto share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bolt for Business only if your buying job matches “Business travel and ground transportation for teams — affiliate partner mapped to HR / ope” rather than Gusto's shape. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than Bolt for Business's shape. Workflow advantage: Bolt for Business leans people-platform; Gusto leans payroll-benefits. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bolt for Business and Gusto share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bolt for Business is Business travel and ground transportation for teams — affiliate partner mapped to HR / operations.; Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22..
- Company-size focus: Bolt for Business (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Gusto (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bolt for Business-leaning people-platform vs Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits.
- Researched limits: Bolt for Business — Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite; Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus.

Limitations — Bolt for Business: Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite; Geographic coverage varies; Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first.

Poor-fit cases: Bolt for Business is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite · Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · Avoid Bolt for Business if you actually need Gusto's motion (US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
